# HD-2D Portfolio

> Interactive 2.5D (HD-2D) personal portfolio inspired by *Valkyrie Profile*'s flower-covered hilltop, pairing a 64px pixel-art sprite with native-MSAA `alphaToCoverage` swaying lilies, depth fog, and parallax layers.

## Read First
- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): Operational, aesthetic, depth-stack, shader, accessibility, and workflow rules.
- [BRAIN.md](BRAIN.md): Active working memory, current phase, locked v1 decisions, asset status, and reordered vertical slice roadmap.
- [docs/designs/hd-2d-flower-hill-portfolio.md](docs/designs/hd-2d-flower-hill-portfolio.md): Finalized v1 technical design, CUJs, architecture, alternatives, NFRs, and 35-file implementation plan.
- [.agents/rules/mcp-routing.md](.agents/rules/mcp-routing.md): MCP tool selection matrix, multi-tool chaining protocols, Graphify usage, and project mappings.

## History
- [CHANGELOG.md](CHANGELOG.md): Keep a Changelog milestone log under `[Unreleased]` and Semantic Versioning.

## Implemented Layout (Slice 1-2)
- [package.json](package.json), [tsconfig.json](tsconfig.json), [vite.config.ts](vite.config.ts), [eslint.config.js](eslint.config.js), [index.html](index.html): Vite + TypeScript + Three.js (`^0.170.0`) + Vitest + ESLint scaffold and DOM mount targets.
- [src/main.ts](src/main.ts): Bootstrap entry wiring validated `nodes.json`, `appState`, `archiveDrawer`, `hudControls`, WebGL init/context-loss fallback, `sceneController`, and `inputRouter`.
- `src/scene/`: [layout.ts](src/scene/layout.ts) world-metric/crop contract, [shaders/wind.glsl.ts](src/scene/shaders/wind.glsl.ts) (`windSway` + monotonic `advanceDriftOffset`), [sky.ts](src/scene/sky.ts) overcast pearl-ivory-beige sky dome, [foliage.ts](src/scene/foliage.ts) hillside terrain + MSAA `alphaToCoverage` `InstancedMesh` lily meadow, [petals.ts](src/scene/petals.ts) `200`-quad tumbling petals, [placeholders.ts](src/scene/placeholders.ts) exact-ratio calibration textures + `.webp`/`.png` loader, [renderer.ts](src/scene/renderer.ts) native-MSAA/diagnostic controller, [camera.ts](src/scene/camera.ts) deadzone spring rig + mouse-look parallax, [hero.ts](src/scene/hero.ts) `NearestFilter` mirrored sprite controller, [plates.ts](src/scene/plates.ts) 5 parallax plates + cloud UV drift + `?debug=1` alignment overlay, and [sceneController.ts](src/scene/sceneController.ts) render/FogExp2/movement loop.
- [src/assets/manifest.ts](src/assets/manifest.ts): Typed asset dimensions, WebP primary plate crop/placement specs (`offsetX`, `offsetY`, `worldWidth`, `worldHeight`), 64px sprite pivot/2px gutters, and audio paths.
- `src/content/`: [nodes.json](src/content/nodes.json) (`[PLACEHOLDER]` v1 schema copy) and [validateNodes.ts](src/content/validateNodes.ts) load-time schema and protocol guard.
- [src/state/appState.ts](src/state/appState.ts): Centralized mode and audio state machine (`TITLE_IDLE`, `EXPLORING`, `DIALOGUE`, `WORKS_PICKER`, `INSPECT_CARD`, `ARCHIVE_DRAWER`, `FALLBACK_ARCHIVE`).
- [src/input/inputRouter.ts](src/input/inputRouter.ts): Unified desktop/mobile pointer and keyboard router with zero-walk wake, `150ms` refocus, and `8px` drag guards.
- `src/ui/`: [styles.css](src/ui/styles.css), [hudControls.ts](src/ui/hudControls.ts) whisper cue and corner Archive trigger, and [archiveDrawer.ts](src/ui/archiveDrawer.ts) accessible HTML `Index/Archive` dialog and fallback view.
- `tests/`: Unit suites at [layout.test.ts](tests/layout.test.ts), [appState.test.ts](tests/appState.test.ts), and [validateNodes.test.ts](tests/validateNodes.test.ts).
- [public/assets/README.md](public/assets/README.md): Master-canvas workflow and pixel-to-manifest crop conversion formulas for owner art drop-in.

## Planned Layout (Slice 3-4)
- `src/scene/landmarks.ts`: 4 interactive hilltop landmarks with soft additive glow planes and world-to-screen projection (Slice 3).
- `src/ui/` & `src/audio/`: `dialogueBox.ts`, `worksPicker.ts`, `inspectCard.ts`, and `audioEngine.ts` (Slice 3).
- `public/assets/sprites/hero.png`: Hot-swappable 64px `NearestFilter` alpha-cutout hero spritesheet (`DoubleSide` mirroring).
- `public/assets/foliage/lily-leaves.png`: Native-res alpha-cutout lily-of-the-valley leaf atlas.
- `public/assets/foliage/lily-bells.png`: Native-res alpha-cutout bell-flower atlas.
- `public/assets/backdrop/citadel.webp`: Far-left silver-white Gothic citadel parallax plate (`.png` accepted locally).
- `public/assets/backdrop/ghost-castle.webp`: Far-center ghostly spired castle parallax plate (`.png` accepted locally).
- `public/assets/backdrop/watchtower.webp`: Right-midground olive-grey watchtower and obelisk parallax plate (`.png` accepted locally).
- `public/assets/backdrop/clouds.webp`: Full-width horizontally tileable (`RepeatWrapping`) overcast cloud bank plate (`.png` accepted locally).
- `public/assets/backdrop/foreground-lip.webp`: Full-width pre-softened foreground flower lip plate in front of the hero's knees (`.png` accepted locally).
- `public/assets/audio/theme.mp3`: Licensed orchestral BGM (`.mp3`/`.m4a` primary, `.ogg` optional) faded in on first pointer/click interaction.

## Optional
- [.agents/rules/antigravity-rtk-rules.md](.agents/rules/antigravity-rtk-rules.md): RTK token-saving CLI rules installed by `rtk init --agent antigravity`.
- `graphify-out/`: Agent-only codebase comprehension graph (git-ignored; updated after each slice).
